string-array.name: privacy_bodies
string-array.item: Website logins and API keys are encrypted with AES-256 and stored only on the Kelo server you run. They never go to kelo.chat or the developer. Each one is tied to the sites it\'s allowed on, so it can\'t be used anywhere else. Values are never shown again, not on screen and not to your agent.

Passwords never go into Chat, only into the Keychain\'s own input field. Your agent only knows that one exists, and the server types it in for the site you registered. Every use is recorded in the usage log, which your agent can\'t read or erase.
Your chat history, uploaded documents and notes are stored on the computer the Kelo server runs on. What you send in a chat does go to the AI service you picked (your model provider).
By default, your agent asks for approval before clicking or typing on the web, writing to connected services, or doing anything that costs money (such as making images).
In My devices, you can disconnect each phone separately. Disconnecting one leaves the rest as they are.
Your agent can\'t run commands on the Kelo server. It only handles files and the web through set tools, and can only open public web addresses.
